'''Oxvar Niph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working as a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] official in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. He was secretly in the pay of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] gang led by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zelice Sturm]], and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] broke into Niph's office to search for clues during an investigation to track down Sturm. However, Niph was alerted to the break in, and he attacked the heroes.
